commits.message:
Project upgrade

- Upgrade to Java 25
- Upgrade to Spring Boot 4.0.1
- Upgrade to Spring Shell 4.0.0
- Upgrade to Apache Maven 3.9.12
- Apply some code adjustments
- Remove Gson dependency
- Add dependency netty-resolver-dns-native-macos to client-shell to remove the ERROR log: Unable to load io.netty.resolver.dns.macos.MacOSDnsServerAddressStreamProvider, fallback to system defaults. This may result in incorrect DNS resolutions on MacOS. Check whether you have a dependency on 'io.netty:netty-resolver-dns-native-macos'. Use DEBUG level to see the full stack: java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError: failed to load the required native library.
